_comment: Room props cut from Kenney's CC0 roguelike indoor tilesheet. Each prop is a grid of cells; a row of three desk tiles makes one long desk. Coordinates are (column, row) on the sheet - render a labelled index with: python.exe tools\art\sheet_grid.py kenney/roguelike-indoors/Tilesheets/roguelikeIndoor_transparent.png --cols 0 14 --rows 8 20

desk._note: Three drawer units in a row - the long desk Choi works at.

shelf._note: Files and folders. Stands in for the duty board.
